notes.title: Speedboat League Devlog #1
notes.content: [p][b]Hey there![/b] A big, big thank you to everyone who support and like the game.[/p][p]Another thank you to the players who reported bugs and sent feedback for Speedboat League. [/p][p][/p][p]We still work on the game and want it to be a great experience for everyone.[/p][p]We will post updates on the progress every now and then, so stay tuned.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Main thing we are focusing on now is changing the drift and boost mechanism for more competetive play - we will post more details soon.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652082/305bac9135e42115c5faafb38a7432a487a1b989.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Frequently Asked Questions:[/b][/p][p]Q: When will the game release?[/p][p]A: We plan to hit end of 2025 or early 2026.[/p][p][/p][p]Q: How many stages will there be in total?[/p][p]A: We aim to have 8 stages at launch with reverse variations.[/p][p][/p][p]Q: Is there split screen?[/p][p]A: Yes, up to 4 players for now. We will look into 6-player split screen.[/p][p][/p][p]Q: Was bathtub stage inspired by Micro Machines?[/p][p]A: Yes! Good catch :D[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you and take care![/p][p]All the best from Blue Sunset Games Team[/p]
